items.text: Corie Moran Adakai has dedicated her life to serving Indigenous communities across our state by promoting health and wellness.

New Mexico, please stay safe out there. Exercise extreme caution around anything that may cause a fire. 

A Red Flag Warning remains in effect.

Funding for the Gibson Gateway Sobering Center will increase community safety & improve outcomes for vulnerable populations by providing a safe place w/ medical monitoring for individuals to gain sobriety & access treatment, housing & other unmet needs. Request: $6.8 million. https://t.co/z7iGfKZS2n

Funding for First Nations Community HealthSource’s behavioral health site would expand access to holistic care for over 15,000 community members to include medical, dental, cultural wellness/Traditional Healing, & other supports for underserved communities. Request: $1 million https://t.co/c29NDvoLlq

• $6.8 million to the Albuquerque Sobering Center—a facility that will be the first of its kind in Albuquerque—to divert individuals with low acuity intoxication to a safe place with medical monitoring to gain sobriety and access treatment, housing and other needs.

I’m heartbroken to learn of the death of 5 Marines during a training exercise while serving our country, including Lance Cpl. Evan Strickland, a 19 year old New Mexican. My thoughts are with his family & loved ones as they grieve this tragic loss. https://t.co/Zib5Tj7Btw

Protecting our lands starts by protecting the wildland firefighters battling fires across NM. That's why I'm proud that @POTUS announced new pay raises, mental health & wellness supports, & a new wildland firefighter job series in the federal hiring system for our firefighters! https://t.co/Y5sFJ9lPq4

We must ensure our communities get the care they need. That's why I'm working alongside our communities & health professionals to develop comprehensive solutions to address provider shortages, barriers to treatment, and expand wraparound services. https://t.co/rpQkl4GRGd

Nutrition programs. Transportation. Supports for caregivers. These are just some of the crucial services that the Older Americans Act funds for our elders. On the anniversary of this landmark law’s 1st passage, we must double down on the resources our communities need to thrive. https://t.co/Q2VMhjn0C2

Request: $6.8 million https://t.co/88ZyCFNTTy

Request: $1 million https://t.co/nIgQtR4BkK

Comprehensive behavioral health care is essential. Yesterday, I was proud to vote to pass House appropriations bills that will provide $460 million for behavioral health, opioid addiction treatment, and substance abuse. https://t.co/hnebqELGUB

We attended the January 6 hearing, marked up a bill to support Puerto Rican self-determination, had our Buffalo Tract Protection Act heard in @NRDems, and stood in solidarity with Congressional staff seeking to exercise their right to unionize. https://t.co/Pd3VHOKGGr

I also joined Mayor Keller and our City Counselors to celebrate the $1.5 million I secured for the construction of the Albuquerque Homeless Youth Center to help us build a world where no young person has to wonder where they'll sleep at night. (2/3) https://t.co/rw4hvmB066

I'm proud that the Inflation Reduction Act:
🩺 Saves New Mexicans thousands on healthcare premiums & prescription drug costs
🌳 Makes the largest investment in climate in U.S. history
👷‍♀️Creates millions of clean-energy jobs
☀️ Supports a just transition to a clean energy future

Are you and your family experiencing the threats of floods from the wildfires that swept through our state? The Here to Help NM program is available for free support, crisis counseling, and treatment. Learn more at https://t.co/MHFKnGNXay
https://t.co/3hgGDpzorN

Having a secure place to sleep is fundamental to the safety and well-being of a young person. That’s why I was proud to secure $1.5 million for Albuquerque’s first Homeless Youth Center to tackle this crisis head-on. https://t.co/PlbY7wUtF0

I’m outraged that a federal judge decided that insurance companies can deny basic medical treatment for HIV. We must double down on funding equitable access to PrEP for our communities to beat the HIV/AIDS epidemic once and for all. https://t.co/tis6NYqlWc

Today, we’re celebrating what the #InflationReductionAct delivers for New Mexicans—a $2,000 annual cap on our elders’ medication costs, lowering premiums by thousands of dollars, and cutting energy bills for a sustainable future. https://t.co/SNbhpNY9B6

This year, I was proud to help pass the Inflation Reduction Act, landmark legislation which will help New Mexicans save hundreds of dollars per year by capping the cost of prescription drugs, lowering healthcare premiums, and expanding coverage. https://t.co/2aI5HE8Mzg

I'm proud that the Inflation Reduction Act—which passed this August—will lower the cost of health care premiums, expand healthcare coverage for tens of thousands of New Mexicans, and cut the cost of prescription drugs, helping to support families & retirees across NM! https://t.co/gNv4HbRQkG

Hey NM! It’s that time of year—it’s Open Enrollment season. Because of the Inflation Reduction Act’s Medicaid expansion & reduced health care premiums, many families can shop for affordable insurance. Explore your options today at https://t.co/vBJvmwJ5LN!  https://t.co/itrXnkiTuO
Hey NM-01! Tonight, remember to turn your clocks back one hour as Daylight Savings comes to an end! Hope you enjoy the extra hour of sleep! https://t.co/1ao9usfydJ

Far too many New Mexicans have tragically lost loved ones to the opioid epidemic. That's why I voted to pass the Rural Opioid Abuse Prevention Act to support our communities in addressing the opioid crisis & expanding access to comprehensive treatment programs. https://t.co/bO5t4GdKj2

Have you signed up for health coverage? Thanks to the #InflationReductionAct, you can get coverage for as little as $10/month! Visit https://t.co/vBJvmwJ5LN today to explore your options to get an affordable healthcare plan before Jan. 15. https://t.co/FXgytAHxt0
